name: Christian Christiansen
source:
Christian is the son of [url=/c64151]Joseph[/url] and [url=/c75323]Mary[/url] and [url=/c76990]Christie[/url]'s twin brother. At Joseph's cookout, they creep [url=/c73297]Amanda[/url] and the [url=/c76975]player character[/url] out by saying "Won't you come play with us?" and "Come play with us. Forever", which is a reference to Stanley Kubrick's movie "The Shining."

[spoiler]On Joseph's first date, Christian and Christie will try once again to creep the player character out by quoting The Shining. Depending on your dialogue choices, you may egg them on and make Joseph laugh by telling them to repeat several more horror film quotes.

On [url=/c64114]Craig[/url]'s second date, if you complete the scavenger hunt, you will discover that Christian and Christie have taken [url=/c76984]River[/url]'s stuffed capybara Arnold and cut him into pieces.[/spoiler] 

[From the [url=https://dreamdaddy.fandom.com/wiki/Christian]Wiki[/url].]
